title: (draft PR) fix a variety of issues with SIG_ALL and its interaction with P2PK and HTLC
body:
Fixes Issue: #1009 which reports a variety of issues related to P2PK and HTLC and SIG_ALL. Even if some of those features have been partially implemented and tested together, problems arise when they are combined; for example, a post-locktime HTLC with SIG_ALL

_Starting with the mint:_

Even if we update Nutshell to use the new SIG_ALL message format (https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/pull/302), it still has the incorrect behaviour on a variety of scenarios involving P2PK and HTLC. See the Issue above for more.

The existing code had NUT-10 code in multiple places. In this PR, following the CDK architecture, all the NUT-10 logic is moved into a single boolean function `_verify_transaction_spending_conditions`. This unifies checking for swap and melt and minimizes code duplication.

That new function first checks if any proof has SIG_ALL. If yes, a SIG_ALL validation is performed; otherwise, a different path is taken to check the proofs individually for compatibility with all the P2PK and HTLC rules.

This PR uses the same `SpendingRequirements` class as used in the CDK, to unify the requirements

_Wallet:_ The only wallet change here is to keep up with the new SIG_ALL message format.

title: A variety of NUT-10 (P2PK and HTLC) problems, mostly with SIG_ALL
body:
With [this compatibility checker for Nut-10 support](https://github.com/SatsAndSports/nut10_compatibility_checker#nutshell-legacy-sig_all), we can see the Nutshell mint has a number of failures. It shows 20 failures, out of the 58 things tested. CDK passes 58 out of 58.

Even when that checker switches to 'legacy' mode for the SIG_ALL message (See https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/pull/302 for context), to take account of the fact that Nutshell still uses the out of date SIG_ALL message format, Nutshell still fails 13/58. Some of those failures are due to incomplete implementation of https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/pull/315

Some of those failures, using the naming scheme of that compatability checker, are:


- `p2pk_sigall_locktime_after_expiry_primary_still_works` Nutshell rejects this after locktime expiry, even though the primary P2PK SIG_ALL spend path should remain valid and the refund path should be additive, not exclusive.
- `p2pk_sigall_multisig_locktime_primary_still_works` Nutshell rejects the primary multisig SIG_ALL path after locktime expiry, instead of continuing to allow it alongside the refund path.
- `htlc_sigall_preimage_only_no_pubkeys_succeeds` Nutshell rejects a valid HTLC SIG_ALL spend with a correct preimage and no pubkeys, even though this should be a valid preimage-only case.
- `htlc_sigall_requires_preimage_and_transaction_signature` Nutshell rejects a valid HTLC SIG_ALL spend with the correct preimage and grouped transaction signature.
- `htlc_sigall_locktime_after_expiry_refund_succeeds` Nutshell rejects a valid HTLC SIG_ALL refund-path spend after locktime expiry.
- `htlc_sigall_multisig_2of3` Nutshell rejects a valid HTLC SIG_ALL 2-of-3 multisig spend.
- `htlc_sigall_receiver_path_after_locktime` Nutshell rejects the HTLC SIG_ALL receiver path after locktime expiry, even though the receiver/preimage path should remain valid.
- `melt_p2pk_sigall_transaction_signature_succeeds` Nutshell rejects a valid P2PK SIG_ALL melt that has the correct grouped transaction signature.
- `melt_htlc_sigall_preimage_only_no_pubkeys_succeeds` Nutshell rejects a valid HTLC SIG_ALL melt with correct preimage and no pubkeys.
- `melt_htlc_sigall_preimage_only_fails` Nutshell returns HTTP 500 for this invalid HTLC SIG_ALL melt case instead of a normal protocol-level rejection.
- `melt_htlc_sigall_preimage_and_transaction_signature_succeeds` Nutshell rejects a valid HTLC SIG_ALL melt with the correct preimage and grouped transaction signature.

title: feat(mint): implement NUT-29 batched minting
body:
## Summary
Implements the NUT-29 batched minting specification on the mint side.

### Details
- **Models**: Added `PostMintQuoteCheckRequest`, `PostMintBatchRequest`, and `PostMintBatchResponse`.
- **API Endpoints**: 
  - `POST /v1/mint/quote/bolt11/check`
  - `POST /v1/mint/bolt11/batch`
- **Ledger Logic**: Implemented `mint_quote_check` and `mint_batch` with strict validations for payment methods, units, states, amount balances, and NUT-20 aggregated signatures.
- **Mint Info**: Advertises `BATCH_MINT_NUT` (29) support with `max_batch_size` based on mint configurations.
- **Tests**: Added full test coverage for the new endpoints and validation logic in `tests/mint/test_mint_api_batch.py`.

*References: [NUT-29 Specification](https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/blob/main/29.md)*
